articles.summary: Cousins Properties (NYSE: CUZ) has released its third quarter 2026 results. Please visit the Investors section of Cousins' website at www.cousins.com to access the Earnings Release and Supplemental Information. Cousins will hold a conference call at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) on Friday, October 30, 2026 to discuss its results. The phone number for the conference call is (800) 836-8184. A replay of the conference call will be available for seven days at (888) 660-6345, passcode 86153#. A webcast of the conference call can be accessed on Cousins' website through the "Cousins Properties Third Quarter Conference Call" link in the Investors section. About Cousins Properties Cousins Properties is a fully integrated, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company, based in Atlanta, GA and acting through its operating partnership, Cousins Properties LP, primarily invests in Class A office buildings located in high-growth Sun Belt markets. articles.summary: Cousins Properties (NYSE: CUZ) announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings after the market closes on Thursday, October 29, 2026 . Cousins will hold its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) . The number for this call is (800) 836-8184 . The live webcast of this call can be accessed on the Company's website, www.cousins.com , through the "Cousins Properties Third Quarter Conference Call" link on the Investors page. A playback will be available shortly after the call on Friday, October 30, 2026 and run through Friday, November 6, 2026. The number for the playback is ( 888) 660-6345 , passcode 86153#. The playback can also be accessed on the Company's website through the "Cousins Properties Third Quarter Conference Call" link on the Investors page.
